## Borrow

The manim block keeps its code untouched; only the other block loses its
`<line=…>` comments.

::: {.explain-code-manim}
```{.python .manim}
from manim import *


class DefaultTemplate(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.next_section("borrow")
```

```{.rust}
fn main() {
    let b = Board::new(); // <line=own>
    take(b);              // <line=own>
}
```

:::: {lines="own" section="borrow"}
Ownership moves into the function.
::::
:::
